notes: Free-market policy research.

notes: FCC. Regulates interstate communications by radio

notes: FEMA. Within DHS. Disaster response and recovery.

notes: Influential in conservative judicial nominations.

notes: FDA. Agency within HHS. Regulates food

notes: GSA. Independent agency. Manages federal property and procurement.

notes: IRS. Bureau of the Treasury Department.

notes: Library of Congress. Legislative-branch agency. Largest library in the world. Includes Copyright Office and CRS.

notes: NASA. Independent agency. Civilian space program and aeronautics research.

notes: NARA. Independent agency. Preserves federal records and presidential libraries.

notes: NCUA. Independent agency. Regulates and insures federal credit unions.

notes: NIST. Within Commerce. U.S. measurement standards laboratory.

notes: NIH. Largest public funder of biomedical research. Within HHS.

notes: NOAA. Within Commerce. National Weather Service

notes: NPS. Within Interior. Manages national parks

notes: NSF. Independent agency. Funds basic research across non-medical sciences.

notes: NSA. Budget classified. Signals intelligence under DoD.

notes: NTSB. Independent agency. Investigates civil transportation accidents.

notes: NRC. Independent agency. Regulates civilian nuclear materials.

notes: OSHA. Within Labor. Workplace-safety regulation.

notes: OSTP. Within EOP. Federal science policy coordination.

notes: Part of the Executive Office of the President.

notes: Smithsonian. Trust instrumentality of the U.S. government. World's largest museum complex.

notes: TSA. Within DHS. Airport screening and transportation security.

notes: USCIS. Within DHS. Immigration benefits adjudication.

notes: USCG. Within DHS (in peacetime). One of the six U.S. armed forces.

notes: Commerce department. Includes Census Bureau

notes: ED. Federal student aid is the largest line item.

name: United States Department of Energy
notes: DOE. Includes NNSA

notes: DHS. Includes CBP

notes: HUD. Public housing

notes: Federal law enforcement department. Includes FBI

notes: Labor department. Includes BLS

notes: U.S. foreign-affairs department.

notes: Land/natural-resources department. Oversees National Park Service

notes: DOT. Includes FAA

notes: VA. Cabinet-level since 1989; medical care

notes: USGS. Within Interior. Scientific agency for natural-resources monitoring.

notes: Lower chamber of Congress. 435 seats; 2-year terms.

name: United States Postal Service
notes: USPS. Independent agency; self-funded.

notes: USSS. Within DHS. Protective and financial-crimes mission.

name: United States Senate
notes: Upper chamber of Congress. 100 seats; 6-year staggered terms.

notes: CBP. Within DHS. Border security and customs at the ports of entry.

notes: ICE. Within DHS. Immigration enforcement and customs investigations.

notes: USMS. Within DOJ. Oldest federal law enforcement agency.
